ctx.x: He would not let them discontinue their act until they became millionaires, each one of his sons, like from Cliff Nazarra to Nat Nazarra, Jr., see, and I'm telling you, this one that plays Mannix, that's one of Nazarra's sons. John Ireland, he's another one. Then, you know, Ben Gazarra, that's one of his sons, see. See, he had -- he was married twice, Nat Nazarra. He had two wives.
So and one of them had -- already had a son -- like a son, you see. It's like what they'd call a half brother, you see, or something.
